extracted.name: Pork Tenderloin with Spanish Rice
extracted.description: Had a Couple Pork Tenderloins in the Freezer from when they were on sale. Decided, to make a one pan roast with rice.
ingredient_lines: 3 diced Serrano peppers, seeds and all
1 1/3 cups Enough Chicken stock to equal, with the tomato sauce,
Soul Food Seasoning to coat the tenderloins
instruction_lines: Add the diced veg to a suitable roasting pan. Combine and measure out 1 1/3 cups total of the tomato sauce and Chicken stock mixed in a measuring cup. Add the spices and seasoning and stir in the cup to combine. Pour in the pan with veg and rice and stir thoroughly.
Layer the Pork Tenderloins atop, and season them thoroughly with the Soul Food Seasoning. Bake at 375 for an hour. Turn off heat, cover the pan with lid, and let sit in the oven for 20 mins.
